crossRefs.note: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

parallels.note: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…

translations.web: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
translations.bsb: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
translations.kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
translations.asv: For what should a man give in exchange for his life?
